question: The value of sqrt{(1+cos θ)/(1-cos θ)} is:
solution:
**Formula used:**

1 - sin² θ = cos² θ 

1/sin θ = cosec θ 

cos θ/sin θ = cot θ 

**Calculation:**

sqrt{(1+cos θ)/(1-cos θ)}

⇒ sqrt{(1+cos θ)/(1-cos θ)times(1+cos θ)/(1+cos θ)} 

⇒ sqrt{((1+cos θ)²)/(1²-cos² θ)} 

⇒ (1 + cosθ)/sinθ 

⇒ (1/sin θ) + (cos θ/sin θ)

⇒ cosec θ + cot θ

**∴ The correct option is 3.**
